thread:
deploy-bot: Started gradual rollout for service="inference-service" version="v4.2.0" -> targeting 5% traffic in us-west, eu-west, ap-south. change window: 2026-03-20 02:00-04:00 UTC. release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/4.2.0

alice: watched, will monitor metrics. @emily FYI.

ben: eu-west p95 for /v1/generate jumped 180ms -> 420ms over last minute. errors +0.7% (baseline ~0.05%).

carmen: grabbing heatmap and logs, looks like a spike in long-tail seqs causing some GPU contention. snippet: ```
2026-03-20T02:12:34Z inference-gen p95=420ms p99=980ms errors=0.8%
pod=r-7f2 node=n3 reason=kvcache-miss-spike
```

dan: oncall check: memory steady, CPU steal high on node n3, several pods reporting longer scheduling latencies. traffic skewed to a few enterprise keys.

emily: is this user visible? any correctness/quality regressions noted in evals?

alice: no quality diffs in the quick eval run, but latency increase will break SLOs for some customers. recommend pause in eu-west and hold global until we triage.

ben: +1. I'll set eu-west canary to 0% and pin that region back to the previous stable (v4.1.9). keep us-west under observation at 5% for now.

carmen: running commands: `deployctl traffic set inference-service --region eu-west --percent 0` && `deployctl pin inference-service --to v4.1.9 --region eu-west` (copy/paste below).

deploy-bot: Executed: traffic set -> eu-west 0% (req_id=d3f4). pin -> v4.1.9 (req_id=d3f5). Canary stopped in eu-west. Continuing to monitor both regions.

dan: created incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/INC-352 — short blameless notes and timestamps logged.

emily: thanks. please capture the timing in the release notes and open a quick RCA if we see the same pattern in us-west.

alice: agreed. scheduling a 15-min async postmortem thread. For now: keep us-west at 5% but DO NOT increase. if p95 in us-west doubles, we stop globally.

ben: ack, adding an alert for p95 doubling and a runbook reminder. :thumbsup:

carmen: leaving a note to add the failing trace ids to the incident doc for easier triage.

deploy-bot: monitoring hooks active; will post updates if metrics cross thresholds.
